text:
Iris (CS): quick mini-runbook draft: two-minute decision tree for prefills, plus rep script + runtime defaults. aiming to reduce renewal friction for small-high-touch accounts.
Ben (CS Ops): nice. can you post the decision tree bullets here? sales needs simple yes/no checks.
Iris (CS): decision tree (3 checks): 1) Is UX interactive (chat-like)? yes/no. 2) Expect >50 first-24h sessions? yes/no. 3) Customer accepts small warmup token spend? yes/no. If >=2 yes -> recommend prefill.
Priya (PM): add a 0/24/72h check cadence and one-line renewal trigger: <3 meaningful sessions in 24h + p95 latency >200ms -> flag for outreach.
Kai (Eng): runtime-safe defaults to recommend in handoff (yaml snippet):
Kai (Eng): ```yaml
warmup:
  enabled: true
  minutes: 20
  target_concurrency: 2
cache:
  edge_ttl_sec: 60
batching:
  max_tokens_batch: 1024
  hold_ms: 25
streaming:
  prefer: true
  grace_ms: 1000
```
Ben (CS Ops): rep-facing micro-script for ticket / email:
Ben (CS Ops): "Subject: Brief warmup before go-live
Hi <Name>, we plan a short warmup to improve first-hour latency and UX. It warms a tiny pool and caches examples for ~1h. Reply to opt out."
alert-bot: created synthetic probe job: tenant-prefill-probe every 3m; alert if p95 >350ms for 10m.
Iris (CS): consent capture: add ticket fields `prefill: yes/no` and `prefill_notes`. capture objections (cost/privacy).
Priya (PM): quick handshake: schedule 15m with SE + CS after go-live to review token use and observed p95. if flagged twice in a week -> auto-assign health check.
Kai (Eng): internal curl to trigger (ops only):
Kai (Eng): ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.api/prefill -H "Auth: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"T-11","steps":6}'
```
Iris (CS): will make a 1-pager and share. thx all. :white_check_mark:
